All ye inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the world<WH08398>, and dwellers<WH07931><WTH8802> on the earth<WH0776>, see<WH07200><WTH8799> ye, when he lifteth up<WH05375><WTH8800> an ensign<WH05251> on the mountains<WH02022>; and when he bloweth<WH08628><WTH8800> a trumpet<WH07782>, hear<WH08085><WTH8799> ye.

They shall be left<WH05800><WTH8735> together<WH03162> unto the fowls<WH05861> of the mountains<WH02022>, and to the beasts<WH0929> of the earth<WH0776>: and the fowls<WH05861> shall summer<WH06972><WTH8804> upon them, and all the beasts<WH0929> of the earth<WH0776> shall winter<WH02778><WTH8799> upon them.

In that time<WH06256> shall the present<WH07862> be brought<WH02986><WTH8714> unto the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635> of a people<WH05971> scattered<WH04900><WTH8794> and peeled<WH04178><WTH8794>, and from a people<WH05971> terrible<WH03372><WTH8737> from their beginning hitherto<WH01973>; a nation<WH01471> meted out<WH06978> and trodden under foot<WH04001>, whose land<WH0776> the rivers<WH05104> have spoiled<WH0958><WTH8804>, to the place<WH04725> of the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, the mount<WH02022> Zion<WH06726>. <RF>scattered...: or, outspread and polished<Rf><CM>
